name: Enshou Honsho
source:
A proud person who isn't very bright. She is always using money regardless on how much she has on hand. She has a strong hatred for [url=/c219]Sousou[/url]. In truth, she is very dependent on [url=/c240]Bunshuu[/url] and [url=/c242]Ganryou[/url] and feels alone and scared without them by her side.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Koihime_Mus%C5%8D_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
